title: Collect browser component activity
goal: Find slow WASM interactions with component metrics and correlated traces.

selectionNotes: WASM; enable diagnostics/export. Local receipt file exporter is alpha.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Automatic WASM component diagnostics registration; the recorded runtime is RC2.

sdk.reason: Matching WASM SDK/runtime assets; actual SDK 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical compiler mode; no C# 15-only syntax is needed.

packages.reason: Matching RC2 component/browser assets; DevServer at the same pin is local test serving only.

packageAssets: Matching WASM packs/JS; OTLP net10.0 assets
prerequisites: Complete standalone project/package files, explicit Razor namespaces/imports, global.json and document are in Markdown. Interpreted WASM uses WasmBuildNative=false; no AOT/native workload is required. Installed authoring workload inventory is recorded separately.

BlazorWebAssemblyDiagnosticsEnabled=true enables MetricsSupport, EventSourceSupport and HttpActivityPropagationSupport unless explicitly overridden. Verify effective build/boot settings. The .NET 10 comparison uses these public lower-level switches and public static AddComponentsMetrics/AddComponentsTracing registration.

Build and retain MeterProvider/TracerProvider before rendering; subscribe both component meters and the component ActivitySource. Configure OTLP HttpProtobuf with full /v1/metrics and /v1/traces paths. A subscription is not export/delivery evidence.

Run the pinned official local collector with the supplied YAML, loopback port 5933, explicit browser origins 5931/5932 and Content-Type CORS. Docker is a local authoring prerequisite, not a Playbook installation dependency. No credentials/account/provider provisioning is required.
constraints: Browser-visible endpoints/configuration must contain no secrets. HTTP is loopback development only; production needs trusted HTTPS, appropriate CORS, authentication/rate limits and privacy/cardinality review.

Periodic metrics and batch traces export asynchronously. Keep the page alive until the collector receives both; synchronous ForceFlush is not an awaited network receipt. Browser close/suspension cannot guarantee final export or Dispose.

Component event/parameter/render-diff timing is not CPU profiling, DOM paint time or whole-interaction latency. Correlate framework event spans, route links and child business-work spans; metrics aggregate separately.

The real .NET 10 manual registration path is a comparison, not a new .NET 10 foundation or an older-target route to this .NET 11 edition. No Server/SSR/Auto, AOT, other-browser/OS, production throughput or GA execution claim.
stabilityLimitations: Stable APIs; framework execution is RC2, not GA. Collector file exporter is alpha; local diagnostic receipts only.
